raw_response:
I farm 12 mu here in Quzhou for fifty years now. My wife and me, our son helps when he come back from town. Every year we do same thing — wheat in winter, maize after wheat come off. That is how everyone do it here.

I cannot read, so I learn from my father and from watching my neighbors. What Old Wang next door do, I mostly do same. If his wheat stand tall and green, I ask him how much bag of fertilizer he put. If it work for him on same soil, it work for me.

For my wheat, I plant in October after maize come off. I use the seed from the shop in town — the dealer he tell me which one everyone buying this year. I don't know the name but it is the new kind, not my grandfather's seed. I buy about 15 kg seed for each mu because I broadcast by hand and some don't come up.

Before planting wheat, I plow the land with the tractor man — he come with his machine, I pay him by the mu. Rotary, turn the soil good. Then I put down the base fertilizer. I use two bag of compound fertilizer for each mu — that is 100 jin, maybe 50 kg. The compound one has all three things in it, the dealer tell me. Then in spring when wheat waking up, I put one more bag of urea, maybe 20 kg each mu. If the wheat look yellow I put a little more. Better put too much than too little — if harvest bad, my family eat what? Fertilizer money is lost but a bad harvest is real suffering.

Water — I have well, so I water wheat maybe 3 time. Once before winter so roots no freeze dry, once in spring when it start growing, once when grain filling. Maize I water 1 or 2 time if rain no come. Summer rain usually enough but last year was dry so I watered twice.

For maize, I plant right after wheat harvest in June. Hybrid seed, everyone use hybrid now. I put one bag compound fertilizer when planting and one bag urea when maize is knee-high. Maize is strong, don't need so much work as wheat.

Pesticide — I spray wheat 2 time for the bug and the rust. Maize I spray 1 time for the borer, sometimes 2 if I see many worm. I buy what the shop tell me, mix like on the bottle.

My yield — good year wheat give me 400 kg each mu, maize give me 500 kg. Bad year less. I hope for good year this time.
